title: Turkish Coffee Fortune Reading
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
This is a visually interactive & group-driven fortune telling experience unlike any other! Your coffee grinds are projected onto a giant monitor allowing for all of the symbols and figures to be witnessed right before your eyes as the one-of-a-kind host interprets them one-by-one. 

Honoring the ancient Turkish coffee fortune ceremonies of the past, this communal experience brings strangers together for an experience that is cosmic, insightful & entertaining!
